description: Homepage intro — eyebrow, section title, three paragraphs and the Core Pillars card grid.

para1.default: Welcome to PRICEMRCOPPER, a dynamic multi-industry enterprise operating at the intersection of global trade and creative media. Based in Singapore, we bridge commerce and culture by managing two core divisions: international goods trading, independent film and music production.

para2.default: We leverage our strategic location in Asia's premier business hub to move physical goods seamlessly across borders, compelling storytelling through featured film making and musical events.

para3.default: At PRICEMRCOPPER, we believe that connecting markets and connecting people through art require the same core values: precision, reliability, and vision.
